text: update_description() sets fields openwashdata standard expects: language, date, repository URL, bug report URL, CC 4.0 license package none yet. text: update_metadata() derives schema.org description dataset DESCRIPTION, dictionary, citation file files inst/extdata, writes JSON-LD pkgdown/templates/-header.html. website build embeds head every page, dataset search engines read . function ends fields fill fill . Nothing edited hand: change source run . function experimental; output shape may still change.

text: setup_readme() writes README.Rmd openwashdata template, installation instructions, download table, section first data object. has_example = TRUE adds Example section scaffold first plot. Write text, add section data object, render :

title: Get started with washr
text: setup_website() writes _pkgdown.yml openwashdata template builds site docs/. template sets Pages URL, analytics header, funding sidebar, reference index one entry per data object. Running keeps _pkgdown.yml rebuilds site. docs/ committed served GitHub Pages; package deploys pkgdown GitHub Actions workflow instead, function leaves docs/ ignored. use_brand() installs openwashdata brand, fonts colors site, central brand repository wires _pkgdown.yml . Run setup_website(), whenever brand changes.

title: Get started with washr
text: update_citation() writes CITATION.cff inst/CITATION DESCRIPTION. Run first release files exist, DOI release deposited Zenodo; guide describes Zenodo steps. DOI function also adds DOI badge README rebuilds site. later run without DOI keeps DOI file. Run update_metadata() , metadata carries DOI well.
code: update_citation() # after the Zenodo release update_citation(doi = "10.5281/zenodo.11185699")
